name: medicine-ball-rollouts
instructions:
1. Assume a tall kneeling (both knees down) stance with your palms facing and your hands resting on a medicine ball.
2. Push the medicine ball forward with your arms extended until your arms are fully overhead.
3. Brace your abs and pull yourself back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
